title: Free Family Portrait Studio
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight organizes a free family portrait studio at the office, inviting coworkers to bring their children for photos, while Jim expresses concern about the safety of the children. Angela suspects Dwight is trying to obtain a DNA sample from her baby to prove paternity, which she denies. Andy reveals he has regained his job as regional manager after convincing David Wallace to buy back Dunder Mifflin, though his coworkers remain skeptical. Meanwhile, Jo Bennett plans to liquidate Sabre, ending the company's existence, and Robert introduces himself as the new CEO. The episode also features Oscar recording a supportive message for gay youth and various tensions and uncertainties around family and work relationships.
